title: The language is part of the address
lead: /en/about, /cs/about, /de/about — each one is a real page written out at build time, which is what a crawler and a search engine both want.

entries.title: Entries, not luck
entries.text: The crawler starts at / and follows links. It cannot invent /cs, so every page under [lang] names its own entries.

matcher.title: A matcher guards the segment
matcher.text: Without it [lang] would swallow /about and every other top-level path.

build.title: Built once, served flat
build.text: No instance is created per request — the pages already exist. The browser gets its own instance for navigation.

note.title: If a language goes missing
note.text: A prerender that exits 0 having built one language looks exactly like a successful build. Assert on the output, not on the exit code.
